tips.th_voiceless: Put the tip of your tongue between your teeth and blow air out.
tips.th_voiced: Tongue between your teeth, blow air and let your throat vibrate (not "d").
tips.final_s: Don't drop the final /s/: end with a soft hiss.
tips.final_z: Final /z/ is a buzzing "zzz", not /s/ and not silent.
tips.final_t_d: Don't swallow final /t/ /d/: touch the ridge behind your top teeth and release.
tips.final_k_g: Don't swallow final /k/ /g/: close at the back of your tongue and release.
tips.final_other: Say the final sound clearly instead of dropping it.
tips.sh_s: /ʃ/ ("sh") is not /s/: round your lips, pull your tongue back, like "shh".
tips.ch_j: /tʃ/ /dʒ/: start with your tongue on the ridge, then release into "ch"/"j".
tips.l_n: /l/ lets air pass the sides of your tongue; /n/ sends it through your nose.
tips.r: English /r/: curl your tongue up without touching the roof of your mouth; don't trill.
tips.v: /v/: top teeth lightly on your lower lip, with voice; not /b/ or /f/.
tips.long_vowel: Long vowels (marked ː) are clearly longer: "sheep" is longer than "ship".
tips.ae: /æ/: open your mouth wide, between "a" and "e" (as in "cat").
tips.schwa: /ə/ is a short, relaxed "uh" in unstressed syllables.
